integrity_notes: The proofs derive the exact statistic and MLE standardization and use Hilbert-space CLT, compensated-Poisson and Pareto truncation. Formula checks are supplementary and are not substitutes for proof. Publication priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Iid, uncensored two-parameter Pareto null; deterministic weight rate tending to infinity; source fixed-weight results are distinct. No result about alternative power, simultaneous tuning, bootstrap levels, or finite-sample fourth-moment convergence for fitted data.
title: A Gaussian–Poisson bandwidth transition for the Pareto min-characteristic goodness-of-fit statistic
